data.sub: Akele ghar nahi kharid sakte the, toh ajnabiyon ke sath milkar kharid liya.

chat.say: Kal se mere room mein bhi 3 naye log shift ho rahe hain!
Toh ab rent bhi sabhi me barabar batega.

data.asar: Real estate me naya jugaad, ab share market ki tarah ghar bhi share honge!
data.caption:
Mehengai ka naya tod! Akele flat lena ab sapna lagne laga hai, toh logon ne naya rasta nikal liya.

🏡 Akele ghar lena hua mushkil
🤝 Ajnabiyon ke sath milkar kharida ghar
💰 Budget ki kami ka naya jugaad

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega jab doston ke sath flat lena pade!

Comment mein batao: Aap kis-kis ke sath ghar share karna chahoge?
